_about: Evidence prompts for the TERMLY briefing (b503). PLACEHOLDERS: Claude fills this file from wren-docs/research/2026-10-15-eef-nursery-world-evidence-cpd.md. Written in our own words, not copied from EEF (their licence does not allow republishing their website text). Each prompt is a question for the room team to answer with something they have actually seen, not a rule.

prompts.prompt: Pick one child you have not had a proper back-and-forth conversation with this week. What did you say, what did they say back, and what will you try next?
Look at your story times from the last fortnight. How often did children get to say something, rather than just listen? Give one example.
Where in today's routine did children count, compare or sort without being asked to? What did the adults say that helped?
Stand at child height in your room for two minutes. What invites a child to start something, and what gets in the way?
